title: Your Heart Give To (Reimagined)
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
You gave your heart away
Like loose change in your palm
To every tired face
To every broken charm

You learned their midnight hurts
You held their falling ground
Now your own hands shake
When no one is around

[Pre-Chorus]
You’ve been wide open
Till the door wore thin
Trying to save everybody
Left you empty in the end

[Chorus]
I’m running out of love
Running out of love
I tried to love everyone
Now I’m coming undone

I’m running out of love
Running out of love
(Out of love)
Baby, save some for me

[Verse 2]
You said yes too fast
When your body said slow

Till you drowned your own

But the mirror knows

You’ve been wide open
Till the door wore thin
Trying to save everybody

[Chorus]

Now I’m coming undone

I’m running out of love
Running out of love
(Out of love)

Let your chest breathe in
You are not a shelter

You can keep your heart
And let some people wait

Just to call it grace

I’m running out of love
Running out of love
I tried to love everyone
Now I’m coming undone

I’m running out of love
Running out of love
(Out of love)
Baby, save some for me

I’m running out of love
Running out of love
(Out of love)
This time, save some for me

title: Video Game Lullaby (reimagined)
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Started with a blank new skin
Fresh eyes, tiny beginner grin
I picked my stats too fast
Brave on paper, brittle fast

Every loss was a map
Every bruise a little scrap
I learned the dark had rules
And fear could be used as fuel

[Pre-Chorus]
So I kept walking through the fog
Kept my hands on what I want
If I fail, I fail out loud
Then I stand up, still unbowed

[Chorus]
I level up, I level up
Not by luck, but showing up
I level up, I level up
Little wins keep filling my cup
New me, new me, step by step
I level up, I level up

[Verse 2]
Side quests taught me patience slow
Who to help, and when to go
Some doors only open wide
When I quit trying to hide

I stopped chasing perfect gear
Started naming what I fear
Now I track the things I choose
Not the points I thought I'd lose

[Pre-Chorus]
So I kept walking through the fog
Kept my hands on what I want
If I fail, I fail out loud
Then I stand up, still unbowed

[Chorus]
I level up, I level up
Not by luck, but showing up
I level up, I level up
Little wins keep filling my cup
New me, new me, step by step
I level up, I level up

[Bridge]
No grand spell, no final boss
Just the cost of being honest
One more try, one more day
Make the map as I go my way

[Final Chorus]
I level up, I level up
Not by luck, but showing up
I level up, I level up
Little wins keep filling my cup
New me, new me, step by step
I level up, I level up
I level up, I level up
And I know what it takes now

title: The Best of Me (Reimagined)
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
I'm looking deep inside
Tried to find this heart I hide
Deep inside my chest
The best of me I ever had

[Verse 2]
I'm looking deep inside 
I checked the mirror for a sign
Found a thousand cracks in the glass
Tried on brave like it was mine
But it never seemed to last

I kept the drawer full of old mistakes
Like receipts I couldn't throw away
Still I woke up, still I stayed
Still I took one step today

[Pre-Chorus]
And I know, I know
There's gold in the rubble
I know, I know
I'm more than my trouble

[Chorus]
Show me the best of me
Buried under dust
Show me the best of me
Still enough, still enough
If I keep digging deep
I'll find my way back home
Show me the best of me
In my own bones

[Verse 2]
There was a scar on my left hand
From the day I let fear win
I wore it like a bad luck band
Till I learned to let it in

Now I water the broken parts
Like a garden in the rain
Little by little, through the dark
Something good begins to change

[Pre-Chorus]
And I know, I know
There's gold in the rubble
I know, I know
I'm more than my trouble

[Chorus]
Show me the best of me
Buried under dust
Show me the best of me
Still enough, still enough
If I keep digging deep
I'll find my way back home
Show me the best of me
In my own bones

[Bridge]
If I am the ache
Then I am the cure
If I am the wound
Then I can endure
I won't call it gone
I won't call it lost
I can be the light
That I thought I forgot

[Chorus]
Show me the best of me
Buried under dust
Show me the best of me
Still enough, still enough
If I keep digging deep
I'll find my way back home
Show me the best of me
In my own bones

title: Warn Night Warm Piano (reimagined)
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
I catch my face in the glass
And I hate that I check it twice
Was I born with a bright loud flame
Or just hungry for every eye?

Maybe good ain't spotless

Maybe I can take up space

If I leave more than I take

If I can choose the we
Over winning every day

I want the line, I want the line
